objs.name: document
objs.description: Paperless managed artifact created, edited, released, distributed, revised, invalidated, archived, reactivated, translated, and displayed in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Selected when creating a new document and used to differentiate documents.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Level used to differentiate documents.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation for a document; not language-independent and same for all languages.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Number assigned to a document abbreviation.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document using TAG technology and is retained or updated through versioning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document and used in the document status network.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader authorizations via a user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign the registered author; the creator is automatically confirmed in this field by default.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reviewers for checking.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign releasers for release.

attributes.name: translator
attributes.description: Attribute used for translation-related authorization assignment.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose changes affect email notification for existing User Groups and persons when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose changes affect distribution of the workflow task when the next version is released.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date calculated from the release of a document and updated for each newly released version.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period defined for each document type to calculate when a validity check is necessary.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from Valid From and Period Of Extended Validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration defined for each document type for archived documents.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type used for company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type used to describe locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details, and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting detailed work steps relevant for a few departments.

objs.name: form
objs.description: Supplement that can be added to work instructions.

objs.name: checklist
objs.description: Supplement that can be added to work instructions.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for each document type and selected when creating new objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or new documents generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object attached to create new documents, additional information, attachments, requests, or change proposals.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Data with which documents can be automatically linked, including IT applications.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process with which documents can be automatically linked or for which process-specific filing of documents is provided.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Master data example with which documents can be linked.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Object used to supplement a document with additional information; released and published directly via switches in properties and not subject to the release cycle of the main document.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document, automatically released with the main document, subject to versioning, and archived with the next version when marked for archiving.

objs.name: equippment
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual user participating as creator, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader, initiator, editor, or acknowledgement recipient.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used to assign authorizations, reader access, author/reviewer/releaser selection, distribution, archive access, and dashboards.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: Group defined in the system and assigned to documents to assign read and change rights to users/persons.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Group- and person-related access assignment for documents.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task created in workflow-supported processing, completed by participants or recipients.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: email_notification
objs.description: Notification used to inform users of workflow tasks, change proposals, validity extension, override, distribution, acknowledgement, and completion.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created and managed for an existing document without affecting document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document 30 days before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a selected document and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to revalidate invalidated documents by selecting the corresponding document for reactivation.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for a document containing User Groups and persons used for read authorization, email distribution, acknowledgement, and dashboards.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation requested from persons and users of assigned User Groups for a released document version.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific display filled from distribution groups and used to list relevant documents.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report or search for documents, instructions, monitoring, status, or acknowledgements.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of released document content, checked and released with workflow support.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select one or more templates defined for a document type when creating new objects.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover for uploading external files or generating documents.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata in document properties.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit document content with an implemented editing client in a local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document after editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically and system-supported convert a saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_document
evts.description: Display the current converted version or relevant document content on the web or dashboard.

evts.name: change_released_document
evts.description: Make changes to a released document, resulting in a new editing version.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group- and person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_reader
evts.description: Assign reader authorizations via a user group assignment in the Reader attribute.

evts.name: assign_author
evts.description: Assign a user as author of a document.

evts.name: assign_co_author
evts.description: Assign additional personal change rights via the Co-Authors attribute.

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Assign reviewers in the document attributes.

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Assign releasers in the document attributes.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Supplement a document with an object of type Additional info.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Supplement a document with an object of type Attachment.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release and publish additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: mark_attachment_for_archiving
evts.description: Mark a released attachment for archiving.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Archive an attachment with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document without affecting content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Document the editing of assigned change proposals directly in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Initiate the workflow-supported 3-step release process after document creation, attribute and content maintenance, and definition of document control.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs the creation of the document in the first workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewers check the content of a document according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releasers complete release so the document is finally released.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: Reject during review or release, canceling workflow for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Workflow participants complete tasks with an electronic signature.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish a document after release so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid and released document, automatically creating a new version in editing status.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the validity expires.

evts.name: process_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Process a request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: declare_additional_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, deleting the request for validity extension and updating Valid until.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process and delete the request when a revised version is released or suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Create a request for AKS for a selected document to invalidate it.

evts.name: process_request_for_aks
evts.description: Process the request for AKS with workflow support.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare a document out of force, retain request for documentation, set status, delete existing edited versions, and revoke rights except archive group.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Archive invalidated documents and attachments by withdrawing authorizations.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation in the provided folder and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start the workflow for a request for reactivation.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Confirm reactivation, creating a new version of the document and retaining metadata and properties.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Reactivate attachments archived with the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain User Groups and persons assigned to document distribution.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_email
evts.description: Inform directly assigned users and users of assigned User Groups by email when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request active acknowledgement by e-mail upon release for persons and users maintained for acknowledgement.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement of a relevant document without a signature.

evts.name: notify_acknowledgement_completion
evts.description: Notify author team when all persons maintained in Distribution have confirmed acknowledgement.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Fill user and role-specific dashboards from distribution groups in the distribution list.

evts.name: evaluate_document
evts.description: Evaluate or search documents, instructions, workflow status, or acknowledgements using reports and selection parameters.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content into another language.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check the translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release the language version so the document is visible in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: specify_document_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not in a multi-client system.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client for a local addition to a document.

evts.name: reference_original_document
evts.description: Create a reference from a local document to the original document.

o2o.description: One or more document templates can be defined for each document type and selected when creating documents.
A pure object cover can be created for a document.
External files or documents can be uploaded to the object cover.
Documents can be linked with Master data.
Documents can be linked with processes and filed process-specifically.
Documents can be linked with organizational units.
Documents can be linked with risks.
Documents can be linked with IT applications.
Documents can be linked with other documents or referenced documents.
A document can be supplemented with additional information.
A document can be supplemented with attachments.
A document can be supplemented with Equippments.
Work instructions can be supplemented with forms.
Work instructions can be supplemented with checklists.
Users can be assigned to User Groups.
User Groups can be assigned to documents for reader authorization, distribution, and archive access.
Persons can be assigned to documents as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, distribution recipient, or reader.
Authorizations are assigned for each document.
Authorization groups are assigned specifically to documents.
A Change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for AKS is created for a selected document.
A corresponding document is selected for reactivation in a request for reactivation.
A distribution list is maintained per document.
User Groups can be assigned to the Distribution list.
Persons can be assigned directly to the Distribution list.
Acknowledgements are confirmed for a current document version.
Relevant documents are assigned and listed in dashboards.
Reports evaluate documents stored in the system.
A translated language version belongs to a document.
For each document in a multi-client system, visibility in clients can be specified.
